From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sales Ops <sales-ops@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Zombie opps rescue + close-window recalibration

Team —

Quick hygiene push: I exported deals that haven't had activity in >60 days and look like they're sitting in late-stage labels without an active next step. I'm calling these "zombie opps." The export is attached (zombie_opps_q3_export.csv). Please do the following by end of day Thursday (9/16):

- Owners: for each deal you still believe is live, update Stage to the correct current stage and set a realistic Close Date (or move to On Hold if you're waiting on PO/legal).
- If the deal is genuinely dead or no longer engaged, change Stage to Closed - Lost and add one short reason in the Deal Notes.
- If you need an exception (e.g., long-running POC with active work), reply to this thread and mark the deal as "POC - exception" with the expected milestone.

Why now: Finance is running a micro-scrub ahead of next week's commit; we need to remove noise and ensure commitable pipeline reflects real activity. This is specifically for deals with: Last activity >= 60 days, Amount >= $25k, Stage in {Negotiation, Contract, Legal, Committed}.

Useful links: hubspot export and the shared sheet where I've flagged items — https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xz-zombie-opps-sheet

If Sales Ops can run an automated filter to surface these by owner, Monica, please do and add a dashboard card for the forecast review.

Thanks — short, sharp action here. If you hit any weird cases, note them in the sheet and loop me in.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: zombie_opps_q3_export.csv (CSV stub — 78 rows)
